# FullTeeSheet

> FullTeeSheet is an all-in-one AI-powered growth platform built exclusively for golf courses. It replaces disconnected tools with a single system covering CRM, booking, Voice AI, Conversation AI, SMS/email marketing, reputation management, memberships, analytics, and payments.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://fullteesheet.com/): Platform overview and value proposition
- [Features](https://fullteesheet.com/features.html): Full feature breakdown — Voice AI, Conversation AI, CRM, automation, analytics, memberships
- [Pricing](https://fullteesheet.com/pricing.html): Plans and what's included
- [Use Cases](https://fullteesheet.com/use-cases.html): How FullTeeSheet solves real problems for golf courses
- [Start a Business](https://fullteesheet.com/new-business.html): The complete roadmap to starting a golf course business — licensing, costs, pricing, first customers — and how FullTeeSheet helps from day one
- [About](https://fullteesheet.com/about.html): Company background and mission
- [Blog](https://fullteesheet.com/resources/blog.html): Golf Course business growth, AI, and operations content
- [Revenue Calculator](https://fullteesheet.com/resources/revenue-calculator.html): Estimate the revenue impact of automation
- [Contact](https://fullteesheet.com/contact.html): Get in touch or book a demo

## Who It's For

golf courses who want to capture more leads, book more jobs, and follow up automatically — without hiring more staff or juggling five different apps.

## Notes

- Built on a full-stack, AI-powered platform (Voice AI receptionist + Conversation AI chat).
- One system: CRM, scheduling, messaging, marketing, reviews, payments, and analytics.
